name: Nigerian Breweries
source: Nigerian Breweries Plc annual report and accounts for the year ended 31 December 2025 (audited, Group/consolidated column), statements of profit or loss page 36 and the Group Five-Year Financial Summary page 115. Currency NGN thousands. FY2025 and FY2024 are the audited consolidated columns; FY2023 to FY2021 are the audited Group five-year summary, which is why Revenue, Operating Profit (EBIT), Profit Before Tax and Net Profit carry all five years while the lines only printed for two years are empty for the older ones. FY2024 Net Profit is profit for the year INCLUDING the 112,754 thousand loss from discontinued operations, so Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax gives 144,883,494 (continuing) and the reported total is 144,996,248. EPS is the Group basic earnings per share, printed in kobo (319 for FY2025 and 1,207 loss for FY2024) and stored here in NGN. Earlier columns of this file mixed the Company/separate series into a Group statement and were replaced; FY2020 was outside the audited five-year window and was not carried. | CRON 2026100315463: Gross Profit filled for FY2023 from Nigerian Breweries Plc audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, 2022 comparative column (the column the file already uses for FY2023, confirmed by its own revenue 599,643,031 and loss before tax -145,224,271), printed gross profit 212,610,459 in N thousands. | CRON 2026100315463: Cost of Sales filled for FY2023 from Derived from the file own sourced figures by the exact identity Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit for Nigerian Breweries FY2023: 599,643,031 less 212,610,459. The 2023 column of the audited statement carries the same revenue and the audit reported gross profit. Marked derived because the identity is exact and both inputs are printed audited figures.
